felix: hi all, day 2. following the runtime build guide but hit a linker error: `undefined reference to std::filesystem::path::lexically_normal`. building on Ubuntu 20 image we inherited. any onboarding tips?

rachel: welcome! :wave: that smells like a libstdc++ ABI issue or an old gcc. what does `g++ --version` show and which libc++/libstdc++ are on your LD path?

felix: `g++ (Ubuntu 7.5.0-3ubuntu1~18.04) 7.5.0`. CUDA is 11.2 on this host and `nvcc -V` lists 11.2.152. I ran `make -j4` and the error occurs at link of `liblibruntime.so`.

rachel: yup gcc7 is ancient for C++17 filesystem symbols in libstdc++. two quick fixes: upgrade toolchain to gcc9+ (we standardize on gcc-10 for dev), or use our dev container which already has matching toolchain + CUDA.

felix: how do I switch safely? sudo not allowed on this VM.

rachel: easiest: use docker: `docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v $HOME/work:/work -w /work gcr.io/redwood-inference/dev:cuda-11.8-gcc-10 bash` then `cmake .. -DUSE_CUDA=ON && make -j6`. That image has gcc-10 and correct libs.

devex-bot: FYI checklist updated: add step to check `g++ --version` before build (PR #412).

felix: tried the container, build passed. will file a small PR to onboarding with the gcc check and note about the old host images. thanks!

infra-bot: created ticket #INFRA-4590 to deprecate Ubuntu18 dev pool images (requester: felix).
